name: Pristine Pesterhide Pelts

angles.text: Kristy's effort to supply her artisan family in Stormwind shows Alliance subjects traveling deep into Kalimdor for rare materials.
Kristy Grant shows the enterprising spirit of Stormwind humans who cross the sea while keeping close ties with kin at home.
Crafters who work with cloth and decorative furs can appreciate Kristy's sisters' plan to turn wild Kalimdor hides into fine garments.

faq.answer: Kristy Grant is a traveler from Stormwind journeying through Kalimdor. She has no fighting experience, but a keen eye for valuable materials, and asks capable travelers to gather goods such as hyena pelts for her.

Pesterhide hyenas are wild predators native to Thousand Needles. They hunt and scavenge in packs across the canyon floor and dusty expanses, and their striking coats catch the eye of travelers who work with hides and fur.

aliases: what does kristy do with the pelts
faq.answer: Kristy Grant wants pristine Pesterhide hyena pelts to send across the sea to her sisters in Stormwind. She admires their color and trusts her sisters to make the furs into fine goods.
faq.q: Why does Kristy Grant want the pelts?

faq.answer: The pelts are bound for Stormwind in the Eastern Kingdoms. Kristy plans to send them across the Great Sea to her sisters, who can work with materials rarely found in Elwynn or Redridge.
faq.q: Where do the pelts end up?

faq.answer: Kristy Grant has no fighting experience, and the wild beasts of Thousand Needles are dangerous. She relies on skilled travelers to hunt the hyenas rather than risk injury or death among their packs.
faq.q: Why can't Kristy hunt the hyenas herself?

faq.answer: The pelts must be undamaged so Kristy's sisters can use their color and texture in fine garments. Careful hunting preserves the best hides.

sections.body: As Kristy Grant crosses the canyon floor of Thousand Needles, the Pesterhide hyenas catch her eye. Their pelts are little known in the Eastern Kingdoms, and she hopes to send some home to her sisters in Stormwind. Skilled hands in her family can turn the hides into fine garments and goods.
sections.title: A Sisterly Ambition

sections.body: Kristy Grant knows craft and trade, but she has no combat experience. Pesterhide hyenas roam beneath the mesas in vicious packs, so gathering their hides alone is dangerous. She relies on seasoned travelers to bring her five undamaged pelts for her sisters to work with back home.
sections.title: Hunters of the Salt Flats and Canyons

summary: In Thousand Needles, Kristy Grant hopes to send Pesterhide pelts to her sisters in Stormwind. They can make the hides into garments and goods, while Kristy relies on travelers to gather them.
